verdict.description: needs-attention if there is any material risk worth blocking on; approve only if no substantive finding can be supported from the packet.

summary.description: A terse ship/no-ship assessment, not a neutral recap.

body.description: What can go wrong, why this code path is vulnerable, and the likely impact.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding anchors to.

recommendation.description: A concrete change that would reduce the risk.

evidence.description: verified = you executed the example and observed the result; illustrative = reasoned, not run.
